techParks.name: Embassy TechVillage
techParks.developer: Embassy Group (owned and managed by Embassy Office Parks REIT since December 2020)
techParks.description: Integrated SEZ/non-SEZ office park on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli Outer Ring Road at Devarabeesanahalli (Bellandur), begun in 2008 as Vrindavan Tech Village and renamed after Embassy Office Parks bought the controlling stake in May 2014 (INR 1,951 crore, 106 acres). Embassy REIT acquired it for about INR 97.8 billion (USD 1.3 billion) in December 2020. REIT disclosures give an 84.05-acre site (the 2018 and 2023 press releases say 103 acres), 9.2 msf leasable (6.1 msf completed, 3.1 msf development as of FY21), 97-98% occupancy and 40+ occupiers employing 45,000+ people. Blocks are named after flowers and plants: Hibiscus (Block 2B, Towers 1-3), Gardenia (2D), Iris (3A), Primrose (7B), Trillium (Blocks I & J), Alyssa/Begonia/Clover (Flipkart's three linked towers), plus numbered blocks 1, 2A-2D, 3A-3B, 5A-5L, 7, 8A-8D, 9A-9C and Block L (WeWork). Parcel 9 is JPMorgan Chase's 1.1 msf built-to-suit corporate centre (opened August 2023); Parcel 8 is a 1.9 msf mixed-use parcel with four office towers and a 518-key dual-branded Hilton / Hilton Garden Inn, facing the ORR and a proposed Metro station. IGBC Platinum green campus (2017) and LEED Platinum O+M.

techParks.name: Cessna Business Park
techParks.description: Office park immediately north-east of Embassy TechVillage, across the Kadubeesanahalli service road, on the ORR. Recorded here only because it is genuinely adjacent to ETV: Cisco's main Bengaluru campus (OSM way 1248882471) and the Aloft Bengaluru Cessna Business Park hotel are inside it. Other researchers' lenses cover its full roster.

coverageNotes: SCOPE AND METHOD. Embassy TechVillage (ETV) was mapped from Embassy REIT and Embassy Group filings and press releases, the park's own occupier page (data dated 30 Sep 2020), tenant companies' own contact pages where they could be fetched, lease news, and every OpenStreetMap office POI inside the park's OSM footprint (way 232970396). The web-search budget ran out after the first two rounds, and roughly a dozen company sites (Xiaomi, Myntra, EXL, Fractal, Moody's, Hilton, Walmart, Intuit, Expedia, Collins Aerospace, Telstra, Lilly, CSG, Software AG) either refused the fetch, were rate-limited or 404'd, so several tenancies rest on the developer's 2020 list or on OSM alone and are marked medium or low accordingly. ROSTER VERDICTS. Confirmed at ETV: Flipkart, Cisco, Sony (now Iris/Block 3A, earlier Hibiscus Tower 2), Wells Fargo (Block 1), ANZ (Hibiscus 2B Tower 1), Myntra (medium; shares Flipkart's campus), JPMorgan Chase (Parcel 9 BTS plus Block 8D), Rubrik, MathWorks (Trillium, Blocks I&J), Quest Global HQ (Primrose 7B), CitiusTech and EXL (Gardenia 2D), WeWork (Block L), plus Eli Lilly, Telstra, Xiaomi, CSG, Great-West, Rockwell Collins/Collins Aerospace and Software AG from the park's 2020 occupier list. NOT at ETV (recorded under their real location where a source allowed, otherwise left out): Juniper Networks (no source places it at ETV; its only hit was a 2008 Embassy Prime/Bagmane note, left out), Lowe's (Manyata Willow L2), Kyndryl (Manyata, 250,000 sq ft, Apr 2024), Rolls-Royce (Manyata GCC, Sep 2025), Cerner/Oracle Health (Manyata Mountain Ash; Oracle's own campus is the Oracle Tech Hub 1.2 km north of ETV), Goldman Sachs (only an OSM node near Embassy GolfLinks; left out), Tesco (OSM node in Whitefield; left out), PhonePe (an OSM node just west of the park at Aurbis Business Park; its HQ is Salarpuria Softzone per my knowledge but no fetched source, left out), Zepto (Bharat IT Park, Harlur, low), Mastercard, Boeing, Nasdaq, Sabre and Groww (no source at all places any of them at ETV; left out rather than guessed). Swiggy's registered office was ETV Blocks I&J but its corporate page now gives Sumadhura Capitol Towers, Whitefield, so the ETV office is marked closed at low confidence. NEIGHBOURS. Embassy Crest (OSM: 12.9866, 77.7271, Whitefield, about 7 km away) and Prestige Ferns Galaxy (12.9217, 77.6690, about 2.5 km south-west) are NOT in or adjacent to ETV and were left out. The genuinely adjacent parks are Cessna Business Park (north-east, Cisco's main campus) and Embassy Tech Square / Umiya Business Bay (north; Omega block, InMobi, LG Soft India per OSM), with RMZ Ecoworld to the west (Deloitte, KPMG Global Services, Intel, Virtusa, KPIT, Allstate, Subex per OSM and KPMG's own page) and Oracle Tech Hub further north; only Cessna and Oracle Tech Hub are recorded as park entries here because the others belong to other lenses. BLOCK NAMES. 'Tower 3B' and 'Lobby' from the brief could not be tied to any tenant by name; OSM's Block 3B carries Warner Bros. Discovery and Block 3A (Iris) carries Sony and Wells Fargo; the flower names confirmed are Hibiscus (2B), Gardenia (2D), Iris (3A), Primrose (7B), Trillium (I&J) and Alyssa/Begonia/Clover (Flipkart). Blocks 8A-8D (Parcel 8, with the 518-key Hilton/Hilton Garden Inn) show Intuit, Rubrik, Expedia and JPMorgan on OSM; only JPMorgan and Rubrik have a non-OSM source. LEFT OUT DELIBERATELY. Sears India (OSM address at Hibiscus Tower 2, but Sears Holdings' 2018 bankruptcy makes current status unknowable from the sources), ValueLabs (OSM placed it at Block 2A but its own site now lists RMZ Infinity for Bengaluru), Prowareness, AgileOne and 'The Standard' (small or ambiguous OSM-only POIs), KPMG Global Services (one OSM node inside ETV, but KPMG's own page puts it at RMZ Ecoworld Campus 7), and Quest Global's Prestige Shantiniketan and Sankey Road offices (listed on its site but no coordinates could be resolved). Headcounts are null everywhere except ANZ (9,000+ Bengaluru, its own page); capacity figures (Flipkart 7,387 seats, Kyndryl 3,000, Rolls-Royce 700) were not entered as headcounts. Park size: REIT filings give 84.05 acres and 9.2 msf; two Embassy press releases say 103 acres and the 2014 release 106 acres; 9.2 msf is recorded and the acreage discrepancy is noted in the description.
